form.name: Name
form.nameInfo: A short internal name for this rule. Operators see it; customers do not.
form.bearerModeInfo: Whether the issued instrument is tied to one customer or can be transferred to another.
form.validFromDateInfo: Optional. The earliest date an instrument under this rule can be used.
form.validUntilDateInfo: Optional. The last date an instrument under this rule can be used. Leave blank for no hard cutoff.
form.expiryDaysInfo: Optional. Number of days after issuance before the instrument expires. Overrides Valid Until when both are set.
form.minAmountInfo: Optional. The smallest face value allowed when issuing under this rule.
form.maxAmountInfo: Optional. The largest face value allowed when issuing under this rule.
form.stackingPolicyInfo: How this instrument interacts with other discounts or instruments at the point of redemption.
form.stackingExclusive: Exclusive — cannot be combined with others
form.stackingFirstOnly: First only — only applied if no other discount is active
form.jurisdictionInfo: Optional ISO 3166-2 code (e.g. PH, US-CA) if this rule applies to a specific region.
form.maxRedemptionsPerInstanceInfo: Optional. How many times a single issued instrument can be redeemed. Leave blank for unlimited.
form.maxRedemptionsPerClientInfo: Optional. How many times any one customer can use instruments under this rule. Leave blank for unlimited.
form.termsUrlInfo: Optional link to the full terms and conditions for this rule.
form.termsSummaryInfo: Optional plain-language summary of the key conditions.

empty.title: No eligibility rules yet
empty.message: Create an eligibility rule to control how instruments issued under this method can be used.
